business: Bracket, a one-person software house based in Kuwait that builds websites, AI booking agents, SEO and GEO for UK small businesses, remotely
by_segment: Established local business (15-40 staff; income = yearly turnover in GBP)
Small team business (4-15 staff; income = yearly turnover in GBP)
Sole trader or micro business (1-3 people; income = yearly turnover in GBP)
why_not: I only use people someone I know has used, and nobody I know has heard of a firm in Kuwait with no UK clients. I already get web designers DMing me every month and I ignore them all, so this goes in the same pile.

My Booksy page and Instagram already bring people in, and I'm not handing 50% upfront by PayPal to a company in Kuwait with no UK office and not one past client to show me. On top of that I don't have the time to write content and go back and forth on scopes at midnight after closing.

I've already got my Fresha booking page and a free Wix site that does the job, so £655 for a new website plus £109 a month for a bot feels like money I don't need to spend. If I did want one, someone in my Facebook group would know a local person who'd do it cheaper.

£655 is a big chunk of my month when Wix or a mate can knock something up for a hundred quid, and the monthly add-ons would just bleed me. Plus I'd still have to write all the content and answer their questions at midnight after closing.
flip: Another owner I know locally telling me they used them, the site came out well and they actually pick up when something breaks.
